title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T – Map, Plots & Payment Plan
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T with the dedicated map, plot sizes, payment guidance, current availability, development checks and buyer verification.
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T is a residential sector within FT-II with a dedicated sector plan, multiple plot-size categories and current installment-based market offers.

Buyers should use the Sector T plan to verify the exact plot, road and surrounding layout, then confirm current plot size, payment schedule, development and final payable amount before booking.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T overview

Sector T is part of Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II and should be reviewed using its own sector plan and current payment terms.

It should not be assumed to follow Sector P, Sector S or another Phase 2 sector automatically.

For a serious purchase decision, confirm:

- exact plot number
- plot size
- road and street position
- payment status
- outstanding charges
- current development
- total payable amount
- physical access

Sector-level marketing is useful for orientation, but the final comparison should always be plot-specific.

## Sector T location and map

Sector T is positioned within the wider Faisal Town Phase 2 layout and connects with the surrounding project through the Phase 2 road network.

Current Sector T-focused material describes access through Boulevard 28, a major boulevard also associated with Sector S and the Overseas Enclave. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

Use the dedicated Sector T plan to identify:

- plot number
- street or internal road
- main boulevard connection
- nearby open areas
- commercial or community-use areas
- corner or non-corner position
- road width
- relationship with adjoining sectors

Do not rely only on a general Phase 2 screenshot when the decision concerns one Sector T plot.

## How to read the Sector T plan

Open the full Sector T PDF first.

Then locate the exact property and review:

- plot dimensions
- road width
- surrounding plots
- internal street layout
- nearby green areas
- parks
- mosque or educational land
- wider sector access

Current Sector T-focused material describes planned parks, a mosque and educational institutions within the sector, but exact locations should be verified against the current plan. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

For mobile users, keep the full plan available and also request a marked crop of the specific plot.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T

Current Sector T-focused material lists the following residential categories:

- 5.56 marla – approximately 25 x 50
- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10.89 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14.22 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

However, there is a current inconsistency in public material around the 14.22-marla category.

The Sector T source includes a 14.22-marla row in its payment table while also noting that some sources report this size as unavailable.

For that reason, buyers should confirm live availability for 14.22 marla before relying on it. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

## Sector T plots for sale

Sector T availability should be checked against current inventory rather than assumed from a payment-plan page alone.

Across Faisal Town Phase 2 more broadly, active plot and plot-file listings exist in several sizes and payment states. Current portal data shows hundreds of Phase 2 plot listings, including cash, installment and plot-file inventory. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

For Sector T specifically, establish whether the property being offered is:

- fresh booking
- installment inventory
- fully paid inventory
- resale property
- plot file
- numbered plot
- partially paid inventory
- inventory carrying outstanding charges

Two plots of the same advertised size may have very different total costs.

## Sector T payment plan

Current Sector T-focused material publishes an installment-oriented payment structure.

Because payment schedules can change and public sources may reuse project-wide pricing frameworks, the exact Sector T payment plan should be reconfirmed before booking.

Ask for a current written schedule showing:

- plot price
- registration fee
- down payment
- remaining balance
- number of installments
- installment frequency
- development charges
- possession charges
- special-location premium
- transfer or processing charges
- any lump-sum discount

Do not rely on an old screenshot or assume that a Sector S or Sector P schedule applies unchanged to Sector T.

## Sector T prices

There should not be one permanent “Sector T price” on this page.

The final payable amount can vary by:

- plot size
- exact street
- road width
- corner position
- main-boulevard location
- park-facing or open-facing position
- payment completion
- outstanding dues
- development status
- seller urgency
- current offer structure

The safest approach is to show a clearly dated current payment reference only when you have the written Sector T schedule in hand.

If the property is resale inventory, compare both the seller's demand and the unpaid developer balance.

## Special-location charges

Sector T plots with preferred positions may carry an additional premium.

Possible examples include:

- corner
- main boulevard
- wider road
- park-facing
- open-facing
- green-facing
- other designated premium locations

Ask for the premium in writing.

A low base price can become significantly higher once location charges, dues and transaction costs are included.

## Sector T development status

Development should be checked at the actual site.

Current Sector T material describes the same broad infrastructure framework used across the expanded Phase 2 cluster, including internal roads and allocated community facilities. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

However, buyers should verify the current condition rather than infer it from a plan.

During a visit or live video inspection, check:

- road formation
- road carpeting
- drainage
- utility infrastructure
- street marking
- plot demarcation
- nearby construction
- machinery on site
- practical access
- current work around the exact plot

## How to review a Sector T plot

A useful review process is:

1. Confirm the property is in Sector T.
2. Obtain the exact plot number.
3. Match it with the Sector T plan.
4. Confirm documented dimensions.
5. Check road and street position.
6. Verify current payment terms.
7. Confirm all outstanding dues.
8. Check special-location charges.
9. Inspect current development.
10. Calculate total payable cost.

This prevents an apparently cheap property from becoming more expensive after unpaid charges are included.

## Sector T vs Sector S

Sector T and Sector S are closely related geographically, but they should not be treated as identical.

Compare:

- plot sizes
- exact road position
- sector layout
- payment structure
- current development
- available inventory
- total payable amount

One current distinction is that Sector T's public size information is less clear around the 14.22-marla category, so live availability matters more here. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6}

## Sector T vs Sector P

Sector P / The Caladan currently has a clearer published commercial offer and should be treated separately.

When comparing Sector T with Sector P, consider:

- same plot size
- final payable price
- installment flexibility
- location
- current development
- special-location premium
- resale status
- intended holding period

Do not import Sector P's discounted full-payment pricing into Sector T unless the developer confirms the same offer applies.

## Who Sector T may suit

Sector T may suit buyers who want:

- a defined Phase 2 sector
- a dedicated plan
- smaller and mid-size residential plot options
- installment-based purchase possibilities
- a location connected to the wider Phase 2 boulevard network

It may be less suitable for a buyer who requires immediate possession or an established resale environment.

Those conditions should be confirmed before booking.

## Is Sector T good for investment?

Sector T may be considered as part of a wider Faisal Town Phase 2 investment comparison.

Before buying, evaluate:

- entry price
- plot size
- exact road position
- development
- outstanding balance
- payment schedule
- resale activity
- competing Phase 2 inventory
- expected holding period
- total acquisition cost

Avoid relying on guaranteed-return claims.

The quality of the exact plot and the price paid matter more than the sector name alone.

## Sector T site-visit checklist

During a site visit, check:

- exact plot
- road width
- route from the main boulevard
- plot level
- surrounding development
- drainage
- street condition
- corner or premium status
- nearby open or community areas
- current accessibility

For remote buyers, request a live video walkthrough, current pin and a marked Sector T plan.

## Do not confuse Sector T with Phase 1

Sector T on this page refers specifically to Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II.

Phase 1 uses block terminology such as Block A, Block B, Block B-1 and Block C.

Always confirm:

- project phase
- sector
- exact plot number
- map reference

before comparing prices or making payment.
